items.q: Hank D'Amico, the terrific clarinetist, and I would follow--- I knew what he was trying to do. I really didn't know the other members of the group too well.

ctx.x: And I found my way in and out in the cracks.
It was quite an experience, because Hank D'Amico, the terrific clarinetist, and I would follow--- I knew what he was trying to do. I really didn't know the other members of the group too well.
